library.name: ESP32_Host_MIDI
library.author: sauloverissimo
library.sentence: MIDI hub for ESP32: USB Host, BLE, Apple MIDI/WiFi, OSC, Ethernet, UART/DIN-5, ESP-NOW.
library.paragraph: Connect USB MIDI keyboards via USB Host OTG; receive BLE MIDI from iPhone, iPad, and iOS apps; bridge DAWs with Apple MIDI / RTP-MIDI over WiFi or Ethernet (W5500/P4); control Max/MSP and Pure Data via OSC; reach vintage DIN-5 synthesizers over serial UART; link ESP32 boards wirelessly with ESP-NOW. All transports share a single event queue and a unified send API; read the queue and resend to bridge one transport to another. Chord detection, active note tracking, PSRAM history, SysEx queue, thread-safe queue. Supports ESP32-S3, S2, P4, and classic ESP32. Arduino IDE, PlatformIO, ESP-IDF.

library.name: UUtzinger_logger
library.author: Urs Utzinger
library.sentence: Library for Arduino logging over Print outputs
library.paragraph: Provides printf-style logging over Serial or another Print output with configurable log levels, LOG, LOGln, LOGI, LOGW, LOGE, LOGD, custom %b binary formatting, optional simple vsnprintf formatting, and optional USE_AUDIO_LOGGING macro conflict avoidance.
